cards.name: Paint Brush Strokes
cards.summary: Periwinkle-violet letters filled with a soft painterly brush-stroke texture and a gentle raised edge (inner bevel, smooth, 5 px, set to use Global Light, so it takes the document's light angle: straight above in the test render, not the stored 120 degrees); the Color Overlay is a violet tint (#330099 at 35%) over the 'artistic strokes' pattern. No shadow or outline, so the letters sit flat on the grey. Effects stored in the style: Bevel & Emboss, Color Overlay, Pattern Overlay.
use_for: art or craft workshop poster title
avoid: small or thin type: the stroke texture is baked at the pattern's native size and muddies letters under about 40 px
busy photo backgrounds: the texture competes with them; keep the ground calm
recolouring by changing the text colour does nothing, the 100% Pattern Overlay hides it: edit the Color Overlay or the pattern in the Layer Style dialog
cards.applies_to: a text, shape or pixel layer (not the locked Background layer: double-click it to unlock first). The effects follow the layer's transparency edge, so it reads best on bold type or a solid shape. Effect sizes are in pixels: on a much larger or smaller document use Layer > Layer Style > Scale Effects.
cards.how_to_apply: Styles panel menu > Import Styles... and pick <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Presets/Styles/Abstract Styles.asl (the harvest did not find this style in the panel's default list); 'Paint Brush Strokes' sits in that library. Then click it with a layer selected. Script: load the file into the style presets (Action Manager set on the application's style list with the file path), then event ASty by panel position.

verified.note: Periwinkle-violet painterly streaks with a soft 5 px bevel and no shadow; the bevel uses Global Light, which in the test document lit it from straight above (global-light shadows elsewhere in the set fall straight down), not from the stored 120 degrees.

review.changes: summary: 'lit from the upper left per the stored settings' replaced: the bevel follows the document's Global Light (straight above in the test render)

avoid: small text: the relief swallows counters and thin strokes

clean or premium brands: the surface reads dirty

Three black Drop Shadows (10% 3 px offset 10 px blur; 15% 26 px offset 30 px blur; 30% 28 px offset 45 px blur) plus a 1 px 35% black inside Stroke that hairlines the letter edge. Effects stored in the style: Drop Shadow, Stroke.
use_for: UI mock-up window, card or icon lift
light or white headline floating over a mid-tone background
soft separation of a logo from a photo
avoid: small text: a 45 px blur smears into a grey cloud
very dark backgrounds: the multiply shadows vanish
tight layouts: the shadow needs room below the letters
